patthana21.13:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ
patthana21.13:2.1: na sārammaṇaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ,
patthana21.13:3.1: na anārammaṇaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.13:4.1: no cittaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā citto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:5.1: hetuyā tīṇi. na akusale tīṇi. na abyākate tīṇi. (saṃkhittaṃ).
patthana21.13:6.1: na cetasikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:8.1: na cittasampayuttaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasampayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:10.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:12.1: na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:14.1: na cittasahabhuṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:16.1: na cittānuparivattiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittānuparivatti kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:18.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:20.1: sahabhuṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāna sahabhū kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:22.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivatti kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:24.1: na ajjhattikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:26.1: na no upādā na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā no upādā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.13:28.1: na anupādinnaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anupādinno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
